rationale_blocks.title: Notability assessment (honest)
rationale_blocks.body: Borderline but defensible under WP:GNG / WP:MANOTE: independent newspaper coverage over 45+ years (Point Reyes Light, Pulitzer-winning weekly, 1980–1998, 8+ mentions; Novato Advance 1996; Herald-Sun Durham 1997, 2001) — caveat: mostly local/regional, the weakest point for AfC reviewers. Counter-argument: published books (Quantum Aikido, Inner Traditions 2025; co-author Art of Transformation 2024); lineage (50+ year student of Nadeau; founder of Aikido of Marin; co-founder City Aikido SF); international guest teaching (NZ since ~1987, Europe). Main risk: reviewers may find coverage too local/primary.

rationale_blocks.title: Name-collision note
rationale_blocks.body: Multiple people named Richard Moon appear in newspaper archives: railway chairman Sir Richard Moon (d. 1899); Rosslyn Park rugby scrum-half (1980s); Grande Prairie AB painter (1980s–90s); Hanover NH photographer (1991); Australian chef; Canadian constitutional-law professor (U. Windsor). None is the aikido teacher — only Marin County CA, Durham NC, and NZ-connected aikido hits qualify. Conversely the subject himself spans facets that look like different people (Source-era chef, moonsic.com musician, executive coach, Cyprus/Bosnia peace worker) — all confirmed by kkron 2026-09-22 as the same man (claim:kkron:moon-unified-identity). JEV identity_match screening excluded all 73 collision listings (49 different_person, 24 insufficient_evidence; scripts/55_jev_moon_analysis.py, data/audit/jev_moon_2026-09-22.json) — a safe-exclusion check, not a claim of 73 correct labels.
